CLOSING. All three children are closed and their changes are Verified +1 / LLM-Review +1 and
submittable on Gerrit.

  e6bd  extract interpret_failure           commit d09784c6b   Gerrit 1123
  8229  build_model_settings/usage_limits   commit c1fc3cee4   Gerrit 1132
  a49e  guard the session with `with`       commit b4b475b04   Gerrit 1140

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA, measured at b4b475b04:

- every child ticket closed: YES (all three above).
- runner.py under 650 LOC: 647. From 689 at the story's base, and from 798 at the point main was
  sitting 2 lines from the 800 hard cap, which is the pressure this story existed to relieve.
- the METHOD figure, RECORDED not gated: `PydanticAIRunner.run()` is 323 lines, from 408. That is
  -85 lines / -21%. I twice set an unreachable bound here (260, then 310) and rather than move it
  a third time to whatever we hit, the criterion now records the measurement and names the owner
  of the remainder: task 5e75 (`build_agent_kwargs` + the ~19-line telemetry block) holds the
  distance to ADR 0056's 60-90 projection. Those are the two extractions that actually shrink the
  METHOD body and were never in this story's scope. The project's real limit is 800 LOC per
  MODULE; runner.py is far inside it.
- EVERY child's commit, as stacked, leaves runner.py under the 700 headroom guard — verified per
  commit, not assumed, because Verified is cast per patchset:
      e6bd d09784c6b  699
      8229 c1fc3cee4  647
      a49e b4b475b04  647
- a49e's commit adds __enter__/__exit__ to the _NoBuildProviderSession stub: DONE in b4b475b04,
  confirmed with `git log -S__enter__ -- tests/interfaces/store/test_execution_mode_dispatch.py`.
- no comment lost a measured fact — evaluated by the deterministic anchor loop this plan now
  carries, over the RUNNER CLUSTER (runner.py OR structured_run.py). All 12 anchors present; the
  command emits nothing. The cluster is the correct scope because relocating code between those
  two files is what this story DOES: the four step-budget anchors (retry-to-exhaustion, bug 59bc,
  pydantic-ai #2593, spy-luge-wool) legitimately MOVED into build_usage_limits under 8229, which
  is a pass, not a loss. An AC scoped to runner.py alone would have failed the story for doing its
  job correctly.
- the provider session is closed on EVERY path including a raise in the pre-call window, asserted
  by a test that failed against the old code: test_a_raise_in_the_pre_call_window_still_closes_
  the_session, confirmed RED before a49e.
- full suite passes with no test ASSERTION changed: 8258 passed / 74 skipped / 0 FAILED at
  b4b475b04. Monkeypatch repoints: e6bd needed ZERO (measured, not assumed), 8229 needed none
  (effective_max_iterations/effective_max_tokens stay re-exported from runner for existing
  importers), a49e owned the one stub repair above.

WHAT THIS STORY ACTUALLY BOUGHT, stated plainly: runner.py 689 -> 647 and run() 408 -> 323, plus a
VERIFIED LEAK CLOSED (an httpx.AsyncClient leaked on every raise in the 151-line pre-call window;
_check_tool_capability raises there by design). The leak fix is the part that was a correctness
bug rather than tidiness, and ADR 0056 was right to sequence it as decision 2.

THE ADR'S OWN THESIS, still true and worth carrying forward: a per-FILE gate is always satisfied
by extracting a CALLEE while the calling method keeps absorbing work. Measured evidence from this
very story: after e6bd extracted the 75-line except spine, run() had GROWN from 357 to 376,
because cc33 put more into the method than the extraction removed. The file bound is not a proxy
for the method bound, and 5e75 carries the rest.
